Kitchen Remodeling in Kechi, KS

Kechi is north Sedgwick County's quiet small town with an increasingly interesting housing mix — older established homes near the original townsite, some mid-century properties, and a growing number of custom new builds on larger rural lots. This diversity means Kechi kitchen remodels span more of the quality and scope range than most communities our size.

A 1950s Kechi farmhouse kitchen is a completely different project than a 2010 custom home kitchen that needs updating. One involves aging construction, original plumbing, and a layout that was never designed for current use. The other involves high-end finishes that are dated but structurally current. We approach them differently.

Wheatland Construction serves Kechi and north Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Kechi Kitchen Remodeling by Vintage

Older homes (pre-1980): Genuine renovation work — assessment for original plumbing and electrical, layout improvement, cabinet replacement, countertop upgrade. Well-and-septic considerations for rural properties.

Mid-century ranches (1970s–1990s): Open-concept conversions are popular; cabinet and countertop replacement; updated lighting and fixtures. These homes have good bones and transform well.

Custom newer builds (2000s–2010s): Material upgrades and targeted improvements at a finish level that matches the home's original quality. Kechi's custom home buyers have higher expectations — we work at that level. Custom or semi-custom cabinets, natural stone or premium quartz, integrated appliance panels if appropriate.

What We Build in Kechi Kitchens

  • Full gut renovations for older homes — plumbing assessment, layout reconfiguration, quality materials
  • Open-concept conversions — structural assessment, wall removal, permit through Sedgwick County
  • Cabinet replacement at appropriate quality level for the home — stock for modest older homes; semi-custom or custom for newer builds
  • Countertop upgrade — quartz standard; natural stone for custom home applications
  • Well-and-septic plumbing — appropriate for rural north Sedgwick County properties

Permits in Kechi

Most Kechi properties are in unincorporated Sedgwick County and permit through the county. Homes inside Kechi city limits use the City of Kechi. We determine which applies.

How We Approach Kitchen Remodeling in Kechi

Every kitchen remodel starts with a site visit. We measure the existing layout, look at the plumbing rough-in and drain stack location, check the electrical panel for capacity, and assess structural walls before discussing what's possible. We price in writing with every line item documented.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. Cabinet delivery, tile setting, countertop templating, plumbing trim-out, electrical, and final inspection all coordinated through us - no handoffs to subcontractors who don't know the project.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

In Kechi, the mix of older farmhouse homes and newer custom builds means we adjust scope and material specification to match the home's original quality level.

Frequently Asked Questions About Kitchen Remodeling in Kechi, KS

How much does kitchen remodeling cost in Kechi, KS?

Kechi kitchen remodels range from $17,000 for a targeted refresh on an older home to $90,000+ for a full custom gut renovation on a newer custom build with high-spec finishes. We provide written, line-item estimates scoped to the home.

What finish level do you work at for Kechi custom homes?

We match the home. Custom Kechi builds deserve custom-quality execution — semi-custom or custom cabinets, premium countertops, integrated details. We discuss finish expectations at the consultation.

Do Kechi rural properties need special plumbing consideration?

Yes for well-and-septic homes. We scope for well-water systems and confirm septic capacity before adding fixtures.

Who handles permits for kitchen remodeling in Kechi?

Most properties use Sedgwick County. City of Kechi for homes inside city limits. We determine which applies.

How long does a Kechi kitchen renovation take?

6–14 weeks depending on scope and finish level. Custom builds with semi-custom cabinet lead times may run 12–18 weeks.

Does a kitchen remodel add value in Kechi?

Yes. Kechi's custom home market values quality improvements proportionally — buyers who chose Kechi are buying the space and quality. A well-executed kitchen remodel returns meaningfully in appraised value and market appeal.
